summary: Mythology-driven action RPG series from Iron Lore/THQ Nordic and Grimlore Games, centered on ancient-world loot, mastery combinations, and post-launch expansions.

entries.title: Titan Quest
entries.definitive_edition: Titan Quest Anniversary Edition on Windows with all expansions

emulation.notes: Use native PC rather than console/mobile capture.

primary.version: Titan Quest Anniversary Edition with Immortal Throne, Ragnarok, Atlantis, and Eternal Embers
primary.why: Windows Anniversary Edition with all expansions is the highest-fidelity and most complete route, combining the base game, Immortal Throne, and the later Ragnarok, Atlantis, and Eternal Embers expansions.
primary.how_to_play: Play Titan Quest Anniversary Edition on Windows with Ragnarok, Atlantis, and Eternal Embers installed; apply modern settings and fixes as needed.
